title: Sadon - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Sadon in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Sadon is a light-element weapon used by Sciel. It scales with Agility (C), Defense (B).

sections.title: How to Get the Sadon
sections.content:
Location: Visages - merchant Blurraga.

sections.title: Is the Sadon Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (C), Defense (B). A dedicated light pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
